baseline.state_init: Only first recorded prefill_begin per service; carry all subsequent state; compare before each request without resetting.
baseline.partition: Exact runtime lex std::sort and selected production partition; A all legacy, C request≤8192 legacy/request>8192 min_new eligible only rows>1; true decode uses global policy but singleton legacy.
baseline.state_boundaries: All16 request entries and32 phase ends×48 layers; prefix1/8/32 counts only.

candidate.name: resident_expert_id_oldest_tick_tie
candidate.rule: Keep empty-slot lowest-index rule. For occupied eligible oldest-tick ties only, compare (tick,resident_expert_id,slot) instead of (tick,slot). All needed/reserved/protected/plan/commit rules fixed.
candidate.entry: Same first service entry as baseline; carry counterfactual states across all requests; never reseed from later observed states.
offline_work_gates: Every one of16 prefill phase load counts must not increase.
Every one of16 decode phase load counts must not increase.
At least one prefill phase must have strictly fewer loads.
Same route/chunk sequence/resolve-call count/capacity/protection contracts, no fallback added.

capacity_bounds.scope: For every phase and layer with actual entry and fixed actual chunk order: first chunk missing from entry, plus adjacent required-set capacity transition lower bounds. Sum per-layer bounds within phase; lower bound need not be jointly achievable.
capacity_bounds.meaning: Actual loads minus lower bound is an upper bound on avoidable loads for these fixed partitions, not demonstrated savings. Entry distinct lower bound is reported separately.

validation.order: Implement core/helper/runner as a group; freeze exact test/build commands and source hashes; run one first bounded host/tool contract batch; only specific failures allow affected reruns.
validation.new_core: Snapshot identity/raw tick restoration, complete-needed exclusion, reservations, duplicate planned hits, protected/empty/LRU ties, singleton runtime classification, chain carry, overflow/invalid rejection.
validation.new_helper: Literal-runtime independent legacy reprobe, C++ equal-key sort, selected production min_new/fallback and singleton/request policy boundaries, malformed inputs.
validation.new_runner: Provenance/schema and no reset, phase/prefix boundaries including8193 singleton, strict mismatch rejection, entire iterator closure, output no-overwrite.
validation.bound_formula: Finite exhaustive set/cache transitions verifying lower-bound inequality, independently of replay implementation.
validation.reuse: Unchanged old trace parser/source-bound HTTP and numerical/tool evidence reused only within original scope.

execution.baseline: One complete four-service replay, stop first concrete mismatch; preserve partial report and only diagnose failed scope.
execution.candidate: One fixed full four-service replay after baseline pass; no favorable reselection/retry.
execution.resources: Host-only generated artifacts under newR or W/.q4t-work; no model/reference payload reads.
execution.runtime_conditional: Offline work gate only permits consideration. Any runtime implementation must separately freeze exact quality/numerical/five-tier+capacity/history/resources and HTTP-first order before build/test. No such work admitted now.

stop_rules: Unreproducible baseline after targeted source/contract fixes: close with exact missing evidence and no candidate claim.
Candidate violates any fixed work gate: record offline rejection; no alternate tie strategy.
Baseline/candidate pass is not E2E, physical IO, quality, or54GB acceptance.
